title: Manage pack details and access
description: Edit a saved pack and revoke private pack access without deleting its audio files.

steps.caption: 1. Open Your Dubs, then Packs to manage published releases and private drafts.
2. Open Private Sessions from its management card.
3. Manage access shows the friends currently granted access to this pack.
4. Revoke removes this pack's grant. Separate file grants and downloads remain unaffected.

target.name: Revoke pack access for Demo Listener

target.text: No friends currently have pack access.

steps.caption: 5. Edit pack reopens its saved details and file arrangement without re-uploading audio.
